about_the_game:
Step into the shoes of seasoned office slackers and embark on an anti-overwork journey through an absurd workplace in this roguelike survival sim blended with choice-driven interactive fiction! Every lazy decision you make shapes the story, unlocking hundreds of quirky endings in a company where absurdity prevails.

Hilarious Slacktivism in an Absurd Workplace

From spilling coffee on the boss’s suit to faking sleepwalking to dodge overtime, uncover 200+ wacky slacking tactics! Colleagues range from AI robots that pilfer your snacks to short-tempered managers on the verge of exploding—anticipate daily servings of side-splitting chaos.

Roguelike Randomness for Fresh Challenges

Office layouts, boss patrol routes, and slacking item spawn points generate randomly, ensuring no two workdays are alike! Level up your skill tree with god-tier abilities such as "Master of Paid Bathroom Breaks" and "Blame Shifting Mastery" to outwit your superiors.

Cringe-Free Ascent to the Top

Strategic slacking earns you experience, allowing you to climb from intern to executive while exploiting the boss’s weaknesses! Will you become the legend of workplace leisure… or get fired and end up on the streets? Your choices craft a unique tale.

Here, slacking isn’t just skiving—it’s a survival art against corporate grind! Ready for a darkly humorous office adventure where outsmarting the system is the key to thriving?
